FN-BGGC4J4-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 157
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/18/2025
House Bill 157 as introduced could increase the obligations of several counties, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2025, by an undetermined amount dependent upon any increase in compensation of
certain county positions equal to the compensation of the prior officeholder of that position,
including any uniform increases received by the prior officeholder.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 157
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/10/2025
House Bill 157 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of several
counties, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, by an undetermined amount dependent upon any
increase in compensation of certain county positions equal to the compensation of the prior
officeholder of that position, including any uniform increases received by the prior officeholder.
